bias.zh: 偏空 · 收盘跌破 200 日均线

read.en: Arm fell 3.1% on Oct 20 to $221.06, trading between $217.26 and $227.19. It is below the falling 5-day ($231.9), 10-day ($250.6), 30-day ($274.4) and 100-day ($293.4) averages and has slipped under the rising 200-day ($224.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7 and below zero, with the histogram flat; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 28 ($273.84), and RSI is 32.8.
read.zh: Arm 10月20日下跌 3.1%，收于 $221.06，盘中区间 $217.26–227.19。股价位于下行的 5 日（$231.9）、10 日（$250.6）、30 日（$274.4）和 100 日均线（$293.4）下方，并跌破上行的 200 日均线（$224.6）。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图持平；抛物线 SAR 自 9月28日起看空（$273.84），RSI 为 32.8。

read.en: The close broke the $225.5–226.7 support (Sep 3, Oct 15 and Oct 16 lows) and the 200-day average, which now act as resistance; the low undercut the $219.4 Aug 3 low before recovering. Resistance is $224.6–226.7, then $232 (5-day) and $238 (Oct 14 close). Support is $217.3–219.4 (Oct 20 and Aug 3 lows), then $200.9 (May 12 low). A close below $217 would open $201.
read.zh: 收盘跌破 $225.5–226.7 支撑（9月3日、10月15日和 10月16日低点）及 200 日均线，两者转为阻力；盘中低点跌破 $219.4 的 8月3日低点后回升。阻力为 $224.6–226.7，其次 $232（5 日均线）和 $238（10月14日收盘价）。支撑为 $217.3–219.4（10月20日和 8月3日低点），其次 $200.9（5月12日低点）。若收盘跌破 $217，下一目标看 $201。
